events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict between Iran and the US has led to increased tensions in the Middle East. The situation is expected to escalate, affecting global oil prices and stock markets. The Atlantic Council has outlined four possible scenarios for the aftermath of the war.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war is expected to disrupt global oil supplies, leading to higher prices. This will benefit oil services companies, while emerging markets may suffer due to increased uncertainty and potential trade disruptions.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil price movements and adjust positions accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Close positions if oil prices drop below $60 per barrel
